hero.name: Ankit Raikwar
hero.title: Infrastructure / Network Engineer
hero.body:
Based in Tokyo. After working in server operations and application support, I now focus on infrastructure and network engineering.

I run a home lab for network build and configuration, and operate my own web applications on Google Cloud — learning the full path from design to operations. I work in both Japanese and English.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Applications I built and operate myself, from development through to deployment on Google Cloud.

homelab.title: Home Lab
homelab.body:
OPNsense running on KVM/QEMU under Ubuntu, with server and client networks segmented.
Firewall rules, NAT, DHCP and network segmentation configured and maintained.

cloud.title: Cloud Operations (Google Cloud)
cloud.intro: This site runs on Google Cloud Compute Engine.
items: Runs as a Docker container, built and deployed by GitHub Actions
Nginx reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt HTTPS
CPU, uptime and external availability monitoring

experience.title: Experience
items: Server operations and incident response (UNIX / Windows)
Application support, log analysis, incident management
Test automation and CI/CD environment setup
